activities.slide: Try it: one transition for all
activities.title: Apply one transition to every slide
activities.intro: Work in your Lab 4 file. Lab 4 asks for transitions applied uniformly, so every slide gets the same one. Tick each step as you finish it.

items: Click any slide, then open the Transitions tab.
Pick Fade or Push from the gallery.
Set Duration to about 0.5 to 1 second. Sound: [No Sound].
Click Apply To All, then press F5 to test.

blocks.prompt: Which step do people miss most often?
In PowerPoint, how can you tell from the thumbnails that a slide has a transition?
options: A small star icon beside it

help: Google Slides: Slide › Transition opens the Motion panel; click Apply to all slides.
Impress: Sidebar › Slide Transition panel › Apply Transition to All Slides.

activities.title: Animate your "What I learned" slide
activities.intro: Make your bullets appear one per click. No Lab 4 file yet? Use any slide with 3 bullets.

items: Select the bullet text box by its border.
Add Appear or Fade, Sequence By Paragraph.
Open the Animation Pane and check the order is 1, 2, 3.
Press Shift + F5 and click through. One bullet per click?

blocks.prompt: All your bullets come in at once. What do you change?
Only one word moves. What went wrong?
options: You selected text, not the box

blocks.prompt: The bullets play without a click. Which Start setting do you need?

help: All bullets at once? Sequence is "As One Object". Change it to By Paragraph.
Only one word moves? You selected text, not the box. Click the border.
Plays without a click? Start is After Previous. Change it to On Click.

activities.title: Quick check: one bullet per click

blocks.prompt: You want your three bullets to show up one per click. What do you use?
options: A Push transition on that slide
An entrance animation, By Paragraph, Start On Click
An exit animation on the text box
